paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists the 100 real-time minigames in Gym-Anything-RT and the capabilities that each minigame and its non-real-time counterpart require.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 列出了 Gym-Anything-RT 中的 100 个实时小游戏，以及每个小游戏及其非实时对应版本所需的能力。

paragraphs.en: Gym-Anything-RT studies six capabilities. Review agents annotate the four capabilities below. The remaining two, interaction and real-time interaction, are varied through the interaction mode and the real-time setting. Appendix H defines when a configuration requires real-time interaction.
paragraphs.zh: Gym-Anything-RT 研究六种能力。 评审智能体对下述四种能力进行标注。 剩余两种能力——交互与实时交互——则通过交互模式和实时设定加以变化。 附录 H 定义了配置何时需要实时交互。

sents.en: Gym-Anything-RT studies six capabilities.
sents.zh: Gym-Anything-RT 研究六种能力。

sents.en: Review agents annotate the four capabilities below.
sents.zh: 评审智能体对下述四种能力进行标注。

sents.en: The remaining two, interaction and real-time interaction, are varied through the interaction mode and the real-time setting.
sents.zh: 剩余两种能力——交互与实时交互——则通过交互模式和实时设定加以变化。

sents.en: Appendix H defines when a configuration requires real-time interaction.
sents.zh: 附录 H 定义了配置何时需要实时交互。

paragraphs.en: The authors define the following criteria for capability annotation. Review agents apply them to the requirements of a solution using screenshots and visible mouse or keyboard controls.
paragraphs.zh: 作者定义了以下用于能力标注的标准。 评审智能体使用截图以及可见的鼠标或键盘控件，将这些标准应用于解决方案的需求。

sents.en: The authors define the following criteria for capability annotation.
sents.zh: 作者定义了以下用于能力标注的标准。

sents.en: Review agents apply them to the requirements of a solution using screenshots and visible mouse or keyboard controls.
sents.zh: 评审智能体使用截图以及可见的鼠标或键盘控件，将这些标准应用于解决方案的需求。

paragraphs.en: We classify visual understanding as 2D or 3D according to the spatial understanding required to solve the task. Decorative perspective alone is insufficient for a 3D label.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据解决任务所需的空间理解能力，将视觉理解分为2D或3D两类。 仅有装饰性透视不足以判定为3D标签。

sents.en: We classify visual understanding as 2D or 3D according to the spatial understanding required to solve the task.
sents.zh: 我们根据解决任务所需的空间理解能力，将视觉理解分为2D或3D两类。

sents.en: Decorative perspective alone is insufficient for a 3D label.
sents.zh: 仅有装饰性透视不足以判定为3D标签。

paragraphs.en: A configuration requires this capability when every general screenshot-only solution must interpret change, motion, order, or duration, remember relevant earlier state that is no longer visible, or control when and for how long an action remains active. The temporal relationship must affect action choice or execution. A simple visible sequence, idle animation, or automatic transition to a static result does not establish this requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 当所有仅依赖通用截图的方案都必须解读变化、运动、顺序或时长，记住不再可见的相关先前状态，或控制某个动作何时激活以及激活多久时，一项配置就需要这一能力。 这种时间关系必须影响动作的选择或执行。 简单的可见序列、闲置动画或自动过渡到静态结果并不能确立这一要求。

sents.en: A configuration requires this capability when every general screenshot-only solution must interpret change, motion, order, or duration, remember relevant earlier state that is no longer visible, or control when and for how long an action remains active.
sents.zh: 当所有仅依赖通用截图的方案都必须解读变化、运动、顺序或时长，记住不再可见的相关先前状态，或控制某个动作何时激活以及激活多久时，一项配置就需要这一能力。

sents.en: The temporal relationship must affect action choice or execution.
sents.zh: 这种时间关系必须影响动作的选择或执行。

sents.en: A simple visible sequence, idle animation, or automatic transition to a static result does not establish this requirement.
sents.zh: 简单的可见序列、闲置动画或自动过渡到静态结果并不能确立这一要求。

paragraphs.en: Solving requires inferring constraints or choosing actions whose consequences affect later decisions. The annotation identifies the relevant inference or action dependency. Basic visual recognition alone does not establish this requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 求解需要推断约束条件，或选择那些其结果会影响后续决策的动作。 标注需要识别出相关的推理或动作依赖关系。 仅有基础的视觉识别并不能确立这一要求。

sents.en: Solving requires inferring constraints or choosing actions whose consequences affect later decisions.
sents.zh: 求解需要推断约束条件，或选择那些其结果会影响后续决策的动作。

sents.en: The annotation identifies the relevant inference or action dependency.
sents.zh: 标注需要识别出相关的推理或动作依赖关系。

sents.en: Basic visual recognition alone does not establish this requirement.
sents.zh: 仅有基础的视觉识别并不能确立这一要求。

paragraphs.en: The agent must interact to reveal relevant information or learn how the interface behaves before solving the task. Routine feedback, an automatic transition that supplies the next required information, or following explicit controls does not establish this requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体必须先进行交互以揭示相关信息或了解界面的行为方式，然后才能完成该任务。 例行反馈、自动转换并提供下一个所需信息的机制，或遵循明确的控制指令，都不符合这一要求。

sents.en: The agent must interact to reveal relevant information or learn how the interface behaves before solving the task.
sents.zh: 智能体必须先进行交互以揭示相关信息或了解界面的行为方式，然后才能完成该任务。

sents.en: Routine feedback, an automatic transition that supplies the next required information, or following explicit controls does not establish this requirement.
sents.zh: 例行反馈、自动转换并提供下一个所需信息的机制，或遵循明确的控制指令，都不符合这一要求。

paragraphs.en: Review agents inspect the implementation and recorded behavior for each difficulty and interaction mode. Each annotation is supported by code or behavioral evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 审查智能体检查每个难度和交互模式的实现与记录的行为。 每条标注都有代码或行为证据支持。

sents.en: Review agents inspect the implementation and recorded behavior for each difficulty and interaction mode.
sents.zh: 审查智能体检查每个难度和交互模式的实现与记录的行为。

sents.en: Each annotation is supported by code or behavioral evidence.
sents.zh: 每条标注都有代码或行为证据支持。

paragraphs.en: The shared runtime controls the execution schedule, and the task clock begins when the environment starts. In live execution, an observation request returns a current frame while the task clock continues. Paused execution advances the task through an observation window and returns a chronological sequence of frames. The clock then stops on the final frame until the action executes and resumes for the next observation window.
paragraphs.zh: 共享运行时控制执行调度，任务时钟在环境启动时开始计时。 在实时执行中，观察请求会返回当前帧，同时任务时钟继续运行。 暂停执行会让任务推进一个观察窗口，并按时间顺序返回一系列帧。 随后时钟停在最后一帧上，直到动作执行完毕，再继续推进到下一个观察窗口。

sents.en: The shared runtime controls the execution schedule, and the task clock begins when the environment starts.
sents.zh: 共享运行时控制执行调度，任务时钟在环境启动时开始计时。

sents.en: In live execution, an observation request returns a current frame while the task clock continues.
sents.zh: 在实时执行中，观察请求会返回当前帧，同时任务时钟继续运行。

sents.en: Paused execution advances the task through an observation window and returns a chronological sequence of frames.
sents.zh: 暂停执行会让任务推进一个观察窗口，并按时间顺序返回一系列帧。

sents.en: The clock then stops on the final frame until the action executes and resumes for the next observation window.
sents.zh: 随后时钟停在最后一帧上，直到动作执行完毕，再继续推进到下一个观察窗口。

paragraphs.en: The observation window and number of frames are set per minigame and are the same for its non-real-time counterpart. The window ranges from 80 to 800 ms with three to six frames.
paragraphs.zh: 观测窗口和帧数是按每个小游戏单独设置的，且与其非实时版本相同。 窗口范围从 80 毫秒到 800 毫秒不等，包含三到六帧。

sents.en: The observation window and number of frames are set per minigame and are the same for its non-real-time counterpart.
sents.zh: 观测窗口和帧数是按每个小游戏单独设置的，且与其非实时版本相同。

sents.en: The window ranges from 80 to 800 ms with three to six frames.
sents.zh: 窗口范围从 80 毫秒到 800 毫秒不等，包含三到六帧。

paragraphs.en: Our action and screenshot path builds on a fast input and output path that we previously developed for a single agent controlling a single sandbox. That design assumes a one-to-one pairing between agent and sandbox. Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) , in contrast, runs many sandboxes behind a central server that launches them and forwards requests to them, and forwarding every action and screenshot through this server adds latency. We therefore separate the two roles. The central server still allocates sandboxes and manages their lifecycle, but actions and screenshots bypass it. The agent’s client runs on the same machine as its sandbox and keeps a persistent direct HTTP connection to an input service inside the sandbox, which executes each action and returns its acknowledgement over this connection. Screenshots are captured natively inside the sandbox as full-resolution JPEG images, encoded once, and returned without resizing or re-encoding. A single request can execute an action and return the subsequent screenshot.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的动作与截图路径建立在之前为单个智能体控制单个沙箱所开发的快速输入输出路径之上。 该设计假设智能体与沙箱之间是一对一的配对关系。 相比之下，Gym-Anything（Aggarwal et al., 2026）在一个中央服务器后面运行大量沙箱，由该服务器启动沙箱并向其转发请求，而将每个动作和截图都经由该服务器转发会带来额外延迟。 因此，我们将这两种角色分离开来。 中央服务器仍然负责分配沙箱并管理其生命周期，但动作和截图会绕过它。 智能体的客户端与其沙箱运行在同一台机器上，并与沙箱内的输入服务保持一条持久的直接 HTTP 连接，该服务执行每个动作并通过此连接返回确认。 截图在沙箱内部以原生方式捕获为全分辨率 JPEG 图像，只编码一次，返回时不进行缩放或重新编码。 单个请求即可执行一个动作并返回其后的截图。

sents.en: Our action and screenshot path builds on a fast input and output path that we previously developed for a single agent controlling a single sandbox.
sents.zh: 我们的动作与截图路径建立在之前为单个智能体控制单个沙箱所开发的快速输入输出路径之上。

sents.en: That design assumes a one-to-one pairing between agent and sandbox.
sents.zh: 该设计假设智能体与沙箱之间是一对一的配对关系。

sents.en: Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) , in contrast, runs many sandboxes behind a central server that launches them and forwards requests to them, and forwarding every action and screenshot through this server adds latency.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Gym-Anything（Aggarwal et al., 2026）在一个中央服务器后面运行大量沙箱，由该服务器启动沙箱并向其转发请求，而将每个动作和截图都经由该服务器转发会带来额外延迟。

sents.en: We therefore separate the two roles.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将这两种角色分离开来。

sents.en: The central server still allocates sandboxes and manages their lifecycle, but actions and screenshots bypass it.
sents.zh: 中央服务器仍然负责分配沙箱并管理其生命周期，但动作和截图会绕过它。

sents.en: The agent’s client runs on the same machine as its sandbox and keeps a persistent direct HTTP connection to an input service inside the sandbox, which executes each action and returns its acknowledgement over this connection.
sents.zh: 智能体的客户端与其沙箱运行在同一台机器上，并与沙箱内的输入服务保持一条持久的直接 HTTP 连接，该服务执行每个动作并通过此连接返回确认。

sents.en: Screenshots are captured natively inside the sandbox as full-resolution JPEG images, encoded once, and returned without resizing or re-encoding.
sents.zh: 截图在沙箱内部以原生方式捕获为全分辨率 JPEG 图像，只编码一次，返回时不进行缩放或重新编码。

sents.en: A single request can execute an action and return the subsequent screenshot.
sents.zh: 单个请求即可执行一个动作并返回其后的截图。

paragraphs.en: We measure latency from immediately before the HTTP request until its complete response, including the image, has arrived. Model inference and subsequent image loading and decoding are outside this measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测量的延迟从 HTTP 请求即将发出之前开始，直到包括图像在内的完整响应到达为止。 模型推理以及后续的图像加载与解码不在此测量范围内。

sents.en: We measure latency from immediately before the HTTP request until its complete response, including the image, has arrived.
sents.zh: 我们测量的延迟从 HTTP 请求即将发出之前开始，直到包括图像在内的完整响应到达为止。

sents.en: Model inference and subsequent image loading and decoding are outside this measurement.

paragraphs.en: In isolated timing tests with one client, we measured 150 sequential requests per condition after five warm-up requests. Median latencies were 39.2 ms for Rotating On-Screen Keyboard, 42.5 ms for an idle LIDAR Blacksite scene, and 46.8 ms while issuing LIDAR scan clicks. The corresponding 95th percentiles were 52.1, 55.3, and 70.7 ms.
paragraphs.zh: 在单客户端的隔离计时测试中，我们在每个条件下先发出五个预热请求，然后测量了 150 个顺序请求。 旋转式屏幕键盘（Rotating On-Screen Keyboard）的中位延迟为 39.2 毫秒，空闲的 LIDAR Blacksite 场景为 42.5 毫秒，发出 LIDAR 扫描点击时为 46.8 毫秒。 对应的第 95 百分位数分别为 52.1、55.3 和 70.7 毫秒。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate GPT-6 Astra with low and xHigh reasoning effort and GPT-6 Luna with xHigh reasoning effort through the Codex CLI. Each GPT model receives a single computer tool. We disable the shell, code execution, web search, browser, and built-in computer-use features. Claude Opus 5.5 with xHigh effort runs through Claude Code with all built-in tools disabled, and receives the same computer tool through an MCP server. Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B are served through the Tinker API with temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, and at most 2,048 output tokens per response. They use their native computer-use function format with coordinates on a 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 grid, and their context contains the last 100 turns with at most 20 screenshots.

paragraphs.en: For the GPT models, each call to the computer tool contains an ordered list of mouse and keyboard actions and returns a screenshot after the actions complete. The actions include moving, clicking, dragging, scrolling, typing, pressing keys, holding and releasing keys and mouse buttons, and waiting. The model instructions and the text after each task description both instruct all models to use only the visible controls of the task webpage, without writing code or inspecting the page. Figure 10 shows the complete prompt for Rotating On-Screen Keyboard in the live setting. In the paused setting, the paragraph following Temporal mode is replaced by the text in Figure 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 GPT 模型，每次对计算机工具的调用都包含一个按顺序排列的鼠标和键盘操作列表，并在这些操作完成后返回一张屏幕截图。 这些操作包括移动、点击、拖拽、滚动、输入、按键、按住和松开按键及鼠标按钮，以及等待。 模型指令和每个任务描述之后的文本都指示所有模型只使用任务网页上可见的控件，而不编写代码或检查页面。 图 10 展示了实时设置下 Rotating On-Screen Keyboard（旋转屏幕键盘）的完整提示词。 在暂停设置中，Temporal mode（时间模式）之后的段落被图 11 中的文本所替代。

paragraphs.en: Solve the task using your own visual reasoning and the computer tool. Choose literal mouse/keyboard inputs or request a screenshot with actions=[]. Writing or executing code, scripts, loops, OCR, automated image processing, and background automation is prohibited. Use only visible controls of the task webpage. Do not open a terminal, external application, browser developer tools, console, inspector, source, DOM, or network panel. Do not navigate, reload, change URLs, inspect hidden state, or switch to unrelated tabs. Use the computer tool with {"actions": [...]} for all observations and inputs. Every call returns the screenshot after its inputs complete. Start with actions=[]. Coordinates use the returned 1920x1080 screenshot at its original resolution: x increases rightward and y downward from [0, 0]. Coordinates are passed directly to the task display. Native env.step input objects (use the fields needed for your action): - Mouse point fields: move, left_click, right_click, middle_click, double_click, triple_click. Each takes [x,y], e.g. {"mouse":{"move":[100,200]}}. - Mouse drag fields: left_click_drag, right_click_drag. Each takes [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]]. - "mouse": {"buttons": {...}} accepts boolean states: left_down, left_up, right_down, right_up, middle_down, middle_up. - "mouse": {"scroll": n} sends n wheel notches, positive down, negative up. These are NOT pixels. To scroll at a point, move the pointer first. - "keyboard" accepts text, keys, keys_down, keys_up. text is a string. keys, keys_down and keys_up accept a key name or a list of key names, e.g. "w", "shift", "ctrl", "left", "space", "Return". keys taps a chord. keys_down presses without releasing. keys_up releases. A separate wait after a tap does not hold the key. There is no duration field on keyboard or mouse. - {"action":"wait", "time":0.2} waits in seconds ("seconds" is also accepted). - {"action":"screenshot"} or [] observes without spending the step budget. A screenshot entry inside a batch does not yield an intermediate frame. Keep distinct inputs in separate list entries when order matters. The runtime processes mouse before keyboard within a combined object, so use keys_down, mouse input, keys_up entries for modifier-held gestures. To draw a curved path, send mouse down, a sequence of mouse moves (and waits if needed), then mouse up. Inputs can stay held across requests and screenshots. Do not replace a held input with repeated taps or type repeated letters to simulate movement.
paragraphs.zh: 使用你自己的视觉推理和计算机工具来解决任务。 选择字面上的鼠标/键盘输入，或使用 actions=[] 请求截图。 禁止编写或执行代码、脚本、循环、OCR、自动化图像处理以及后台自动化。 只使用任务网页上可见的控件。 不要打开终端、外部应用、浏览器开发者工具、控制台、检查器、源代码、DOM 或网络面板。 不要导航、重新加载、更改 URL、检查隐藏状态或切换到无关的标签页。 所有观察和输入都使用带有 {"actions": [...]} 的计算机工具。 每次调用都会在其输入完成后返回截图。首次调用请使用 actions=[]。 坐标基于返回的 1920x1080 截图并按其原始分辨率计算：x 从 [0, 0] 向右增加，y 向下增加。 坐标会直接传递给任务显示界面。 原生 env.step 输入对象（按你的操作使用所需字段）：- 鼠标点击字段：move、left_click、right_click、middle_click、double_click、triple_click。 每个字段接受 [x,y]，例如 {"mouse":{"move":[100,200]}}。- 鼠标拖拽字段：left_click_drag、right_click_drag。 每个字段接受 [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]]。- "mouse": {"buttons": {...}} 接受布尔状态：left_down、left_up、right_down、right_up、middle_down、middle_up。- "mouse": {"scroll": n} 发送 n 个滚轮刻度，正数向下，负数向上。这些不是像素。 要在某一点滚动，请先移动指针。- "keyboard" 接受 text、keys、keys_down、keys_up。text 是字符串。keys、keys_down 和 keys_up 接受一个键名或键名列表，例如 "w"、"shift"、"ctrl"、"left"、"space"、"Return"。keys 表示敲击一个组合键。keys_down 按下但不释放。keys_up 释放。 敲击之后的单独 wait 不会保持该按键。 键盘和鼠标都没有 duration 字段。- {"action":"wait", "time":0.2} 以秒为单位等待（也接受 "seconds"）。- {"action":"screenshot"} 或 [] 进行观察且不消耗步骤预算。 批次内的截图条目不会产生中间帧。 当顺序重要时，请将不同的输入放在单独的列表条目中。 运行时在同一个组合对象中会先处理鼠标再处理键盘，因此对于需要按住修饰键的操作，请使用 keys_down、鼠标输入、keys_up 的条目顺序。 要绘制曲线路径，请发送鼠标按下、一系列鼠标移动（如有需要可加 wait），然后鼠标抬起。 输入可以跨请求和截图保持按下状态。 不要用重复点击代替保持按下的输入，也不要输入重复字母来模拟移动。

sents.zh: 使用你自己的视觉推理和 computer 工具来解决该任务。

sents.en: Choose literal mouse/keyboard inputs or request a screenshot with actions=[].
sents.zh: 选择字面上的鼠标/键盘输入，或通过 actions=[] 请求截图。

sents.en: Writing or executing code, scripts, loops, OCR, automated image processing, and background automation is prohibited.
sents.zh: 禁止编写或执行代码、脚本、循环、OCR、自动化图像处理以及后台自动化。

sents.en: Use only visible controls of the task webpage.
sents.zh: 只能使用任务网页上可见的控件。

sents.en: Do not open a terminal, external application, browser developer tools, console, inspector, source, DOM, or network panel.
sents.zh: 不要打开终端、外部应用、浏览器开发者工具、控制台、检查器、源代码面板、DOM 或网络面板。

sents.en: Do not navigate, reload, change URLs, inspect hidden state, or switch to unrelated tabs.
sents.zh: 不要导航、刷新、更改 URL、检查隐藏状态或切换到无关的标签页。

sents.en: Your answer only counts once it is submitted: after completing the task, press the visible submit/confirm/verify control and check the UI acknowledges it before you declare the task finished.
sents.zh: 只有在提交后答案才被计入：完成任务后，按下可见的提交/确认/验证控件，并确认 UI 已作出响应后，才能宣告任务完成。

paragraphs.en: The task clock is paused while you reason and while inputs are delivered. Each screenshot request or step response advances one configured observation window, returning its frames in chronological order. The task then freezes on the final frame, and the next input acts on that state. A wait sleeps in wall time but does not advance the paused task clock. To hold a key or mouse button while the task advances, send down in one request and up in a later request. Additional screenshot requests advance additional windows while the input stays held. Down, wait, up in a single batch does NOT advance paused task time between down and up.
paragraphs.zh: 当你进行推理以及输入被投递时，任务时钟处于暂停状态。 每次截图请求或步骤响应都会推进一个已配置的观察窗口，并按时间顺序返回其帧。 之后任务定格在最后一帧，下一个输入将作用于该状态。 等待会按实际时间休眠，但不会推进已暂停的任务时钟。 若要在任务推进期间按住某个按键或鼠标按钮，请在一个请求中发送按下（down），在稍后的请求中发送释放（up）。 在输入保持按住期间，额外的截图请求会推进额外的窗口。 在单个批次中执行按下、等待、释放，并不会在按下与释放之间推进已暂停的任务时间。

paragraphs.en: Each attempt allows at most 100 steps. A step is one request that contains one or more actions in order. Requests that only return a screenshot do not consume steps. Each attempt has a time limit of six hours, except that attempts of Astra (xHigh) on the real-time tasks at 1 × 1\times , 4 × 4\times , and 16 × 16\times slowdown and in the paused setting have a limit of one hour. Attempts that reach the time limit count as failures. We exclude and rerun attempts that end with a provider or infrastructure error. The task verifier determines whether each attempt succeeds.
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试最多允许 100 步。 一步是指包含一个或多个按顺序执行的动作的一次请求。 仅返回屏幕截图的请求不消耗步数。 每次尝试的时间限制为六小时，但 Astra (xHigh) 在实时任务中以 1 × 1\times 、4 × 4\times 和 16 × 16\times 减速以及暂停设置下的尝试时间限制为一小时。 达到时间限制的尝试计为失败。 我们排除并重跑以提供商或基础设施错误结束的尝试。 任务验证器判定每次尝试是否成功。

paragraphs.en: In the coding experiment, the model runs in the Codex CLI with its standard tools inside an isolated sandbox. It receives an HTTP endpoint that accepts the same actions and returns screenshots, together with a short Python client. The model can write programs that process screenshots and issue actions through this endpoint. Access to the task machine, page source, and browser developer tools remains prohibited.
paragraphs.zh: 在编码实验中，模型在 Codex CLI 中运行，在隔离沙箱内使用其标准工具。 它会获得一个 HTTP 端点，该端点接受相同的操作并返回屏幕截图，同时还提供一个简短的 Python 客户端。 模型可以编写程序，通过这个端点处理屏幕截图并发出操作。 对任务机器、页面源代码和浏览器开发者工具的访问仍然被禁止。

sents.zh: 在编码实验中，模型在 Codex CLI 中运行，在隔离沙箱内使用其标准工具。

sents.zh: 它会获得一个 HTTP 端点，该端点接受相同的操作并返回屏幕截图，同时还提供一个简短的 Python 客户端。

sents.zh: 模型可以编写程序，通过这个端点处理屏幕截图并发出操作。

paragraphs.en: For the experiment in Section 4.8 , each rulebook describes a minigame’s controls, action effects, fixed world rules, feedback, submission, and recovery. It excludes generated answers, target coordinates, hidden state, and seed-specific layouts or solutions. The rulebook is appended to the task prompt, and all other settings remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 对于第 4.8 节中的实验，每本规则手册描述了一个小游戏（minigame）的操作方式、动作效果、固定世界规则、反馈、提交与恢复机制。 它不包含生成的答案、目标坐标、隐藏状态以及与种子相关的布局或解法。 规则手册被附加到任务提示词之后，所有其他设置保持不变。

sents.en: For the experiment in Section 4.8 , each rulebook describes a minigame’s controls, action effects, fixed world rules, feedback, submission, and recovery.
sents.zh: 对于第 4.8 节中的实验，每本规则手册描述了一个小游戏（minigame）的操作方式、动作效果、固定世界规则、反馈、提交与恢复机制。

sents.en: It excludes generated answers, target coordinates, hidden state, and seed-specific layouts or solutions.
sents.zh: 它不包含生成的答案、目标坐标、隐藏状态以及与种子相关的布局或解法。

sents.en: The rulebook is appended to the task prompt, and all other settings remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 规则手册被附加到任务提示词之后，所有其他设置保持不变。

paragraphs.en: One of the authors played 20 tasks randomly sampled from the 100 real-time tasks at difficulty 5 with full interaction in the live setting, seeing each minigame for the first time. Each task used the same seed that the models received. The author solved 9 of the 20 tasks (45.0%), with an average time of 132.7 seconds, or 2.2 minutes, per task.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一位作者在实时环境中以完全交互的方式，随机抽取了100个难度为5的实时任务中的20个进行游玩，且每个小游戏均为首次接触。 每个任务都使用了与模型相同的种子。 该作者解决了20个任务中的9个（45.0%），平均每个任务用时132.7秒，即2.2分钟。

sents.en: One of the authors played 20 tasks randomly sampled from the 100 real-time tasks at difficulty 5 with full interaction in the live setting, seeing each minigame for the first time.
sents.zh: 其中一位作者在实时环境中以完全交互的方式，随机抽取了100个难度为5的实时任务中的20个进行游玩，且每个小游戏均为首次接触。

sents.en: Each task used the same seed that the models received.
sents.zh: 每个任务都使用了与模型相同的种子。

sents.en: The author solved 9 of the 20 tasks (45.0%), with an average time of 132.7 seconds, or 2.2 minutes, per task.
sents.zh: 该作者解决了20个任务中的9个（45.0%），平均每个任务用时132.7秒，即2.2分钟。

paragraphs.en: We examine saved trajectories from Astra’s coding evaluation at difficulty 5 with full interaction in the live setting. In Rotating On-Screen Keyboard, the model uses perspective transforms and image templates to locate requested keys, converts their positions to screen coordinates, and clicks them. In Wrong Number, it fits curves to waveform pixels from screenshots, estimates the phase error, and adjusts a slider. In Clockwork Clutch Safe, it tracks the marker on each gear, estimates the marker’s angular speed from recent screenshots, and releases each clutch when the marker is predicted to reach its target angle. All three attempts pass the task verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查了 Astra 在难度 5、完全交互的实时环境下编程评测的保存轨迹。 在“旋转屏幕键盘”中，模型使用透视变换和图像模板来定位所请求的按键，将其位置转换为屏幕坐标，并点击它们。 在“错误号码”中，模型对截屏中的波形像素拟合曲线，估计相位误差，并调整滑块。 在“发条离合器保险箱”中，模型跟踪每个齿轮上的标记，根据最近的截屏估计标记的角速度，并在预测标记到达目标角度时松开每个离合器。 这三次尝试都通过了任务验证器。

sents.zh: 我们检查了 Astra 在难度 5、完全交互的实时环境下编程评测的保存轨迹。

sents.zh: 这三次尝试都通过了任务验证器。

paragraphs.en: Image-based control also appears in failed attempts. In Gyroscopic Tilt Board, Astra detects the ball and direction indicator, estimates velocity, and moves the tilt control along a sequence of waypoints, but the attempt fails. These examples show how scripts can process observations and issue actions between model responses.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图像的控制也出现在失败的尝试中。 在陀螺仪倾斜板任务中，智能体检测小球和方向指示器，估计速度，并沿一系列路径点移动倾斜控制，但该尝试失败了。 这些示例展示了脚本如何在模型响应之间处理观测并发出动作。

sents.zh: 这些示例展示了脚本如何在模型响应之间处理观测并发出动作。

paragraphs.en: The real-time label is assigned to a fixed difficulty and interaction configuration. Let H t H_{t} denote the visible interaction history through task time t t , I t I_{t} the agent’s own prior actions and their task times, and W t w W_{t}^{w} the visible window from t − w t-w to t t . Let u u denote the terminal task outcome, with less task-active continuation time after delivery of the next action used only to break ties between equal outcomes. Expectations use visible task information and average over future randomness. Private generator or page state is unavailable to the policy.

paragraphs.en: A grouped control mode D D contains every occurrence, across seeds, rounds, and attempts, of the same outcome-affecting control mode. Let C Δ ​ ( D ) C_{\Delta}(D) contain the histories in D D from which success remains possible after a delay Δ \Delta with no new action. Only histories that become unsalvageable after this delay are excluded. Let A Δ ∗ ​ ( H t ) A^{*}_{\Delta}(H_{t}) be the set of actions maximizing expected u u when delivered at t + Δ t+\Delta and followed by optimal continuation. Let H t τ H_{t}^{\tau} be the history after τ \tau with no new action, and Q ⁡ ( H t , a ) Q(H_{t},a) the expected u u when a a is the next action and is followed by optimal continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 分组控制模式 D D 包含同一影响结果的控制模式在所有种子、轮次和尝试中出现的每一次。 设 C Δ ( D ) C_{\Delta}(D) 为 D D 中在延迟 Δ \Delta 且无新动作之后成功仍有可能的历史。 仅排除那些在此延迟之后才变得无法挽回的历史。 设 A Δ ∗ ( H t ) A^{*}_{\Delta}(H_{t}) 为在 t + Δ t+\Delta 时刻执行并在其后采取最优延续时，使期望 u u 最大化的动作集合。 设 H t τ H_{t}^{\tau} 为经过 τ \tau 且无新动作之后的历史，Q ( H t , a ) Q(H_{t},a) 为当 a a 是下一个动作并在其后采取最优延续时的期望 u u。

paragraphs.en: For the configuration-level label, a configuration is classified as not real-time if at least 50% of its generated instances admit a successful pre-run solution. After preparation, such a solution starts the autonomous outcome phase and sends no further outcome-affecting actions until that phase ends. Final submission or certification is administrative and is excluded from this action count. Reviewers establish this threshold from source evidence or a reproducible seed probe. If the threshold is unresolved and could change a positive mathematical classification, the reviewer returns unresolved . Failure of any mathematical condition already establishes a negative classification.
paragraphs.zh: 对于配置级标签，若某个配置生成的实例中至少有 50% 存在可成功预运行的解，则该配置被归类为非实时。 准备完成后，此类解即启动自主结果阶段，并在该阶段结束前不再发送任何影响结果的操作。 最终提交或认证属于行政性操作，不计入此操作计数。 审阅者根据源证据或可复现的种子探针确定此阈值。 若阈值未定且可能改变肯定的数学分类结果，审阅者返回 unresolved。 任何数学条件不成立即已确立否定的分类结果。

sents.zh: 子句 (iii) 中的自主演化必须在 `W_t^w` 内有可见的证据，且该证据必须正是使子句 (i) 和 (ii) 中的延迟最优动作依赖于观察的原因。

sents.en: The window must support prediction of the evolution’s effect at `t+Delta`; unrelated idle animation or future randomness independent of the window cannot supply clause (iii).
sents.zh: 该窗口必须支持对演化在 `t+Delta` 时刻之效果的预测；与该窗口无关的空闲动画或独立的未来随机性无法满足子句 (iii)。

paragraphs.en: The evidence may appear across consecutive frames or as an accumulated visible trace, chart, or trajectory in one screenshot. A single screenshot is allowed when it visibly contains the relevant temporal evidence. This does not admit a static puzzle next to an unrelated animation.
paragraphs.zh: 证据可能出现在连续的多帧画面中，或在同一张截图中以累积的可见痕迹、图表或轨迹呈现。 当单张截图明显包含相关的时间性证据时，允许使用单张截图。 这不包括在无关动画旁边放置一道静态谜题的情形。

paragraphs.en: `Delta` is a reported witness horizon on the time scale of the task behavior, not the current provider’s response latency. It must begin inside a nontrivial active control opportunity and may extend across the point at which that opportunity gets worse or closes. The configured `observation_window_ms` and `frames_per_observation` bound `w`; they do not force every environment to need every captured frame.
paragraphs.zh: `Delta` 是在任务行为时间尺度上报告的见证地平线（witness horizon），而非当前提供商的响应延迟。 它必须始于一个非平凡的活动控制机会之内，并且可以延伸越过该机会变差或关闭的那个时间点。 所配置的 `observation_window_ms` 和 `frames_per_observation` 限定了 `w` 的范围；它们并不强求每个环境都需要用到每个已捕获的帧。

paragraphs.en: The conjunction has these required consequences:
paragraphs.zh: 这个合取具有以下必然后果：

paragraphs.en: - Clause (i) rules out a fixed schedule or a policy driven only by the agent’s own action clock.
paragraphs.zh: - 条款 (i) 排除了固定时间表或仅由智能体自身动作时钟驱动的策略。

paragraphs.en: - Clause (ii) requires a bounded recent visual window to be sufficient. This excludes unobservable randomness and information that must be recalled only from outside the window.
paragraphs.zh: - 条款 (ii) 要求有界的近期视觉窗口即可充分。 这排除了不可观测的随机性，以及只能从窗口之外回忆起来的信息。

sents.en: - Clause (ii) requires a bounded recent visual window to be sufficient.

sents.en: This excludes unobservable randomness and information that must be recalled only from outside the window.

paragraphs.en: - Clause (iii) requires a useful action opportunity to get worse inside the delay because the task state changes. This excludes fixed waits, minimum-duration holds solvable from the agent’s own clock, and information that remains actionable indefinitely.
paragraphs.zh: 条款 要求由于任务状态发生变化，有用的行动机会在延迟期间内变得更差。 这排除了固定等待、可由智能体自身时钟解决的最短时长保持，以及无限期保持可操作性的信息。

sents.en: - Clause (iii) requires a useful action opportunity to get worse inside the delay because the task state changes.

paragraphs.en: - A stationary visual policy is allowed. It can map the currently evidenced changing state to an action without using absolute task time.

paragraphs.en: Record whether the threshold is met, with source-structural evidence or an actual reproducible seed probe. A failed existing solver does not prove that no pre-run solution exists. Do not invent a percentage. If the threshold cannot be determined and it could change a mathematical Yes into No, return unresolved. A configuration that already fails the mathematical definition is No regardless of an unresolved pre-run rate.

paragraphs.en: The launcher supplies the exact public environment name, environment ID, game CASE_INDEX, and CONFIGURATIONS list. paragraphs.en: This appendix expands on the related work discussion in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录对第 5 节中的相关工作讨论进行了扩展。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks for vision-language agents span web, desktop, mobile, game, and embodied environments. Web benchmarks such as WebArena and VisualWebArena provide self-hosted websites with realistic tasks ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ) , while desktop benchmarks such as OSWorld and Windows Agent Arena evaluate open-ended tasks across operating system applications ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Bonatti et al., 2024 ) . OSWorld 2.0 further extends this setting to 108 long-horizon workflows, where the best agent completes only 20.6% of tasks ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . On mobile, AndroidWorld provides tasks across 20 Android apps ( Rawles et al., 2024 ) , and Programming with Pixels and Gym-Anything extend computer-use evaluation to software engineering and to 200 professional software applications ( Aggarwal & Welleck, 2025 ; Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) . Game benchmarks evaluate the same models on complete games, ranging from classic video games ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and reinforcement learning environments such as NetHack ( Paglieri et al., 2025 ) to platformers, puzzle games, and browser games ( Hu et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025a ; Ying et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) . ARC-AGI-3 evaluates exploration and goal inference in turn-based abstract games, where humans solve all environments while frontier models solve less than 1% ( ARC Prize Foundation, 2026 ) . Embodied benchmarks similarly evaluate agents in simulated homes and physical environments ( Savva et al., 2019 ; Shridhar et al., 2020 ; Srivastava et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2025c ) . However, since each task in these benchmarks requires many capabilities at once, low performance does not identify which capability limits the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的视觉-语言智能体基准测试涵盖网页、桌面、移动、游戏和具身环境。 网页基准测试如 WebArena 和 VisualWebArena 提供自托管的网站和真实任务（Zhou et al., 2024; Koh et al., 2024），而桌面基准测试如 OSWorld 和 Windows Agent Arena 评估跨操作系统应用的开放式任务（Xie et al., 2024; Bonatti et al., 2024）。 OSWorld 2.0 进一步将该设置扩展到 108 个长时程工作流，其中最佳智能体仅完成 20.6% 的任务（Yuan et al., 2026）。 在移动端，AndroidWorld 提供跨 20 个 Android 应用的任务（Rawles et al., 2024），而 Programming with Pixels 和 Gym-Anything 将计算机使用评估扩展到软件工程以及 200 个专业软件应用（Aggarwal & Welleck, 2025; Aggarwal et al., 2026）。 游戏基准测试在完整游戏上评估相同的模型，范围从经典电子游戏（Zhang et al., 2026）和诸如 NetHack 之类的强化学习环境（Paglieri et al., 2025），到平台游戏、益智游戏和浏览器游戏（Hu et al., 2025a; Zheng et al., 2025a; Ying et al., 2026; Ouyang et al., 2026）。 ARC-AGI-3 在回合制抽象游戏中评估探索和目标推断能力，人类能解决所有环境，而前沿模型解决的任务不足 1%（ARC Prize Foundation, 2026）。 具身基准测试同样在模拟家庭和物理环境中评估智能体（Savva et al., 2019; Shridhar et al., 2020; Srivastava et al., 2021; Yang et al., 2025c）。 然而，由于这些基准测试中的每项任务都同时需要多种能力，低性能并不能识别出究竟是哪种能力限制了智能体。

paragraphs.en: Several works attempt to attribute performance to individual capabilities. SmartPlay maps each of its six games to a subset of nine agent capabilities ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , LVLM-Playground evaluates perception, question answering, rule following, and end-to-end play separately on the same board games ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , and Embodied Agent Interface decomposes embodied decision making into separate modules, arguing that final success rates cannot pinpoint which ability is missing ( Li et al., 2024 ) . VS-Bench similarly reports perception, strategic reasoning, and decision making separately ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Other benchmarks vary conditions of the same task, such as difficulty tiers ( Davydova et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) , initial states ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , or interface changes between actions ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . However, these works either operate through text or turn-based interfaces, or vary a single condition without controlling the capabilities a task requires. In contrast, Gym-Anything-RT annotates the capabilities required by each configuration, and varies difficulty, interaction interface, and real-time setting on the same minigame.
paragraphs.zh: 若干工作尝试将性能归因于单个能力。 SmartPlay 将其六个游戏分别映射到九项智能体能力的一个子集（Wu et al., 2023），LVLM-Playground 在相同的棋盘游戏上分别评估感知、问答、规则遵循和端到端游玩（Wang et al., 2025c），而 Embodied Agent Interface 将具身决策分解为多个独立模块，认为最终成功率无法定位缺失的是哪项能力（Li et al., 2024）。 VS-Bench 同样地分别报告感知、策略推理和决策（Xu et al., 2026）。 其他基准通过改变同一任务的条件，例如难度层级（Davydova et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025b）、初始状态（Zhao et al., 2025）或动作之间的接口变化（Liu et al., 2026）。 然而，这些工作要么通过文本或回合制接口运行，要么只改变单一条件而不控制任务所需的能力。 相比之下，Gym-Anything-RT 标注了每种配置所需的能力，并在同一小游戏上改变难度、交互接口和实时设置。

paragraphs.en: A large body of work evaluates individual capabilities of VLMs through question answering. For 3D spatial understanding, VSI-Bench, MindCube, 3DSRBench, and OmniSpatial evaluate spatial relations, viewpoint changes, and mental models of scenes ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ) , while BLINK shows that perception tasks that humans solve easily remain difficult for multimodal models ( Fu et al., 2024 ) . For temporal reasoning, TempCompass, TOMATO, and Vinoground evaluate speed, direction, and event order in videos ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Shangguan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , with TOMATO showing that many questions in earlier video benchmarks can be answered from a single frame. For GUI grounding, SeeClick and ScreenSpot-Pro evaluate whether models can locate screen elements from instructions ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Finally, PuzzleVQA, AlgoPuzzleVQA, and VisualPuzzles evaluate abstract and algorithmic reasoning over images ( Chia et al., 2024 ; Ghosal et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , and MMMU and MMMU-Pro evaluate multidisciplinary reasoning over images and text ( Yue et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) . However, in all of these benchmarks the model answers a question about a static input, without having to act on its understanding. Closer to our work, iVISPAR evaluates the spatial reasoning of VLM agents on a sliding-tile puzzle presented in 3D, 2D, and text ( Mayer et al., 2025 ) , and VisGym provides 17 interactive environments with configurable difficulty and input representation ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Gym-Anything-RT complements these works by covering temporal reasoning, exploration and interface understanding, and real-time interaction, and by annotating the capabilities required by each configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 大量工作通过问答来评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的各项能力。 在3D空间理解方面，VSI-Bench、MindCube、3DSRBench和OmniSpatial评估空间关系、视角变化以及场景的心理模型（Yang et al., 2025a; Wang et al., 2025b; Ma et al., 2024; Jia et al., 2025），而BLINK表明人类易于解决的感知任务对多模态模型而言仍然困难（Fu et al., 2024）。 在时序推理方面，TempCompass、TOMATO和Vinoground评估视频中的速度、方向和事件顺序（Liu et al., 2024; Shangguan et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024），其中TOMATO表明早期视频基准中的许多问题仅凭单帧即可回答。 在GUI定位（grounding）方面，SeeClick和ScreenSpot-Pro评估模型能否根据指令定位屏幕元素（Cheng et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025）。 最后，PuzzleVQA、AlgoPuzzleVQA和VisualPuzzles评估对图像的抽象与算法推理（Chia et al., 2024; Ghosal et al., 2024; Song et al., 2025），而MMMU和MMMU-Pro评估对图像与文本的多学科推理（Yue et al., 2024; Yue et al., 2025）。 然而，在上述所有基准中，模型只是回答关于静态输入的问题，而无需基于其理解采取行动。 与我们的工作更接近的是，iVISPAR在以3D、2D和文本形式呈现的滑块拼图上评估VLM智能体的空间推理能力（Mayer et al., 2025），VisGym则提供了17个难度和输入表示均可配置的交互式环境（Wang et al., 2026b）。 Gym-Anything-RT通过涵盖时序推理、探索与界面理解以及实时交互，并为每种配置标注所需能力，对上述工作形成补充。

sents.en: A large body of work evaluates individual capabilities of VLMs through question answering.
sents.zh: 大量工作通过问答来评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的各项能力。

sents.en: For 3D spatial understanding, VSI-Bench, MindCube, 3DSRBench, and OmniSpatial evaluate spatial relations, viewpoint changes, and mental models of scenes ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ) , while BLINK shows that perception tasks that humans solve easily remain difficult for multimodal models ( Fu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 在3D空间理解方面，VSI-Bench、MindCube、3DSRBench和OmniSpatial评估空间关系、视角变化以及场景的心理模型（Yang et al., 2025a; Wang et al., 2025b; Ma et al., 2024; Jia et al., 2025），而BLINK表明人类易于解决的感知任务对多模态模型而言仍然困难（Fu et al., 2024）。

sents.en: For temporal reasoning, TempCompass, TOMATO, and Vinoground evaluate speed, direction, and event order in videos ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Shangguan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , with TOMATO showing that many questions in earlier video benchmarks can be answered from a single frame.
sents.zh: 在时序推理方面，TempCompass、TOMATO和Vinoground评估视频中的速度、方向和事件顺序（Liu et al., 2024; Shangguan et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024），其中TOMATO表明早期视频基准中的许多问题仅凭单帧即可回答。

sents.en: For GUI grounding, SeeClick and ScreenSpot-Pro evaluate whether models can locate screen elements from instructions ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 在GUI定位（grounding）方面，SeeClick和ScreenSpot-Pro评估模型能否根据指令定位屏幕元素（Cheng et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Finally, PuzzleVQA, AlgoPuzzleVQA, and VisualPuzzles evaluate abstract and algorithmic reasoning over images ( Chia et al., 2024 ; Ghosal et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , and MMMU and MMMU-Pro evaluate multidisciplinary reasoning over images and text ( Yue et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 最后，PuzzleVQA、AlgoPuzzleVQA和VisualPuzzles评估对图像的抽象与算法推理（Chia et al., 2024; Ghosal et al., 2024; Song et al., 2025），而MMMU和MMMU-Pro评估对图像与文本的多学科推理（Yue et al., 2024; Yue et al., 2025）。

sents.en: However, in all of these benchmarks the model answers a question about a static input, without having to act on its understanding.
sents.zh: 然而，在上述所有基准中，模型只是回答关于静态输入的问题，而无需基于其理解采取行动。

sents.en: Closer to our work, iVISPAR evaluates the spatial reasoning of VLM agents on a sliding-tile puzzle presented in 3D, 2D, and text ( Mayer et al., 2025 ) , and VisGym provides 17 interactive environments with configurable difficulty and input representation ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 与我们的工作更接近的是，iVISPAR在以3D、2D和文本形式呈现的滑块拼图上评估VLM智能体的空间推理能力（Mayer et al., 2025），VisGym则提供了17个难度和输入表示均可配置的交互式环境（Wang et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: Gym-Anything-RT complements these works by covering temporal reasoning, exploration and interface understanding, and real-time interaction, and by annotating the capabilities required by each configuration.
sents.zh: Gym-Anything-RT通过涵盖时序推理、探索与界面理解以及实时交互，并为每种配置标注所需能力，对上述工作形成补充。

paragraphs.en: Acting in dynamic environments requires accounting for the delay between observing the environment and executing an action. In robotics, real-time action chunking and asynchronous inference execute previously planned actions while the next chunk is computed ( Black et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ) , and VLASH conditions the policy on the state predicted at execution time ( Tang et al., 2025 ) . Reinforcement learning has similarly studied decision making under action and observation delays ( Ramstedt & Pal, 2019 ; Derman et al., 2021 ) . For computer-use agents, OSWorld-Human measures end-to-end latency and finds that agents take 2.7 to 4.3 times more steps than necessary ( Abhyankar et al., 2026 ) . Game benchmarks have taken different approaches to latency. GameWorld pauses the game during inference and reports a separate real-time study with two models ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) , VideoGameBench runs games in real time and additionally provides a Lite version that pauses the emulator while the agent is thinking ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and Orak compares paused and real-time play on StarCraft II ( Park et al., 2025 ) . Real-Time Reasoning Gym advances text-based games after a fixed number of generated tokens, comparing reactive and planning agents under increasing time pressure ( Wen et al., 2026 ) . Our work complements these efforts by evaluating the same minigame and seed in the live, slowed, and paused settings, and by pairing each real-time minigame with a non-real-time counterpart.
paragraphs.zh: 在动态环境中行动需要考虑观察环境与执行动作之间的延迟。 在机器人领域，实时动作分块与异步推理会在计算下一块动作的同时执行先前规划的动作（Black et al., 2025；Shukor et al., 2025），而 VLASH 则让策略以执行时刻预测的状态为条件（Tang et al., 2025）。 强化学习同样研究过存在动作延迟与观察延迟时的决策问题（Ramstedt & Pal, 2019；Derman et al., 2021）。 在计算机使用智能体方面，OSWorld-Human 测量了端到端延迟，并发现智能体所需的步骤数是必要步骤数的 2.7 至 4.3 倍（Abhyankar et al., 2026）。 游戏类基准对延迟采取了不同的处理方式。 GameWorld 在推理期间暂停游戏，并单独报告了一项针对两个模型的实时研究（Ouyang et al., 2026）；VideoGameBench 以实时方式运行游戏，并额外提供一个 Lite 版本，在智能体思考时暂停模拟器（Zhang et al., 2026）；Orak 则在《星际争霸 II》上比较了暂停模式与实时模式下的表现（Park et al., 2025）。 Real-Time Reasoning Gym 在生成固定数量的词元后推进基于文本的游戏，在日益增加的时间压力下比较反应式智能体与规划式智能体（Wen et al., 2026）。 我们的工作通过在实时、减速和暂停三种设置下评估相同的小游戏与种子，并将每个实时小游戏与非实时对应版本配对，对这些已有工作形成了补充。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work uses coding agents and LLMs to construct environments for agents. Gym-Anything uses a creation agent and an independent audit agent to convert 200 software applications into computer-use environments ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) . CUA-Gym separates an agent that constructs environment states from one that writes reward functions ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and GUI-GENESIS converts real applications into lightweight web environments with executable rewards ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . AutoEnv generates 36 text-based environments with 358 levels ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , while AgentGen and OMNI-EPIC generate environments together with tasks of varying difficulty ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Faldor et al., 2024 ) . Similar pipelines construct software engineering tasks from code repositories ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) and 3D scenes for embodied agents ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Procedural generation further provides task instances with adjustable complexity, including Procgen games ( Cobbe et al., 2019 ) , MiniHack and BabyAI ( Samvelyan et al., 2021 ; Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ) , and verifiable reasoning problems in Reasoning Gym and Enigmata ( Stojanovski et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . However, these approaches construct software, text, or game environments, and do not produce interactive visual minigames whose difficulty and interaction interface can be varied while preserving the underlying task. We extend the creator-auditor approach to such minigames, where each minigame has a non-real-time counterpart, five difficulty levels, two interaction modes, and an oracle solution.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的工作使用编码智能体和大语言模型来构建面向智能体的环境。 Gym-Anything 使用一个创建智能体和一个独立的审计智能体，将 200 个软件应用转换为计算机使用环境（Aggarwal et al., 2026）。 CUA-Gym 将构建环境状态的智能体与编写奖励函数的智能体分离（Wang et al., 2026a），而 GUI-GENESIS 将真实应用转换为带有可执行奖励的轻量级网页环境（Cao et al., 2026）。 AutoEnv 生成了 36 个包含 358 个关卡的文本环境（Zhang et al., 2025），而 AgentGen 和 OMNI-EPIC 则同时生成环境以及不同难度的任务（Hu et al., 2025b；Faldor et al., 2024）。 类似的流程还从代码仓库构建软件工程任务（Pan et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2025b），并为具身智能体构建 3D 场景（Yang et al., 2024）。 程序化生成进一步提供了复杂度可调节的任务实例，包括 Procgen 游戏（Cobbe et al., 2019）、MiniHack 和 BabyAI（Samvelyan et al., 2021；Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019），以及 Reasoning Gym 和 Enigmata 中的可验证推理问题（Stojanovski et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025）。 然而，这些方法构建的是软件、文本或游戏环境，并不能生成交互式视觉小游戏——这类小游戏能在保持底层任务不变的前提下改变难度和交互界面。 我们将创建者-审计者方法扩展到此类小游戏，其中每个小游戏都具有一个非实时对应版本、五个难度级别、两种交互模式以及一个标准解法。

paragraphs.en: Many of the seed minigames in Gym-Anything-RT are derived from CAPTCHAs and puzzle games. CAPTCHA research has studied whether automated solvers can pass challenges designed to distinguish humans from bots. Recent works solve reasoning and visual CAPTCHAs with LLMs and VLMs ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Teoh et al., 2025 ) , analyze which types of challenges remain difficult for these models ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , and train GUI agents on interactive CAPTCHAs ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Open CaptchaWorld evaluates web agents on 20 types of interactive CAPTCHAs, where the best agent achieves 40.0% compared to 93.3% for humans ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . Beyond CAPTCHAs, KORGym, DiG-bench, and VGRP-Bench evaluate multi-turn reasoning in text, game, and grid puzzles ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Battleday et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2025 ) . However, these works primarily target security or reasoning in isolation. In contrast, Gym-Anything-RT uses such challenges as seed minigames, and adds controlled capability requirements, difficulty levels, interaction interfaces, and real-time settings.
paragraphs.zh: Gym-Anything-RT 中的许多种子小游戏源自验证码（CAPTCHA）和益智游戏。 验证码研究探讨的是自动化求解器能否通过那些旨在区分人类与机器人的挑战。 近期工作使用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）求解推理类和视觉类验证码（Deng et al., 2024；Teoh et al., 2025），分析哪些类型的挑战对这些模型仍然困难（Wang et al., 2025a；Wu et al., 2025），并在交互式验证码上训练图形用户界面（GUI）智能体（Chen et al., 2026）。 Open CaptchaWorld 在 20 类交互式验证码上评估网页智能体，其中最佳智能体达到 40.0%，而人类为 93.3%（Luo et al., 2025）。 除验证码之外，KORGym、DiG-bench 和 VGRP-Bench 在文本、游戏和网格谜题中评估多轮推理能力（Shi et al., 2025；Battleday et al., 2026；Ren et al., 2025）。 然而，这些工作主要单独针对安全性或推理能力。 相比之下，Gym-Anything-RT 将此类挑战用作种子小游戏，并增加了可控的能力要求、难度等级、交互界面和实时设置。
